neighbours.label: 'in'/'with' opening a manner phrase after a celebratory or showy action, where 'in style' is the expected continuation (a next-token predictor for 'style')
fire: Ring in the new year in style at our rooftop party.
The champions rode through the city in an open bus.
Travel to the wedding in comfort with our luxury coaches.
Show off your team spirit with these bright scarves.
Graduates left the ceremony in high spirits.
End your holiday in luxury at the seaside spa.
The band closed the festival with a spectacular encore.
Make your grand entrance in a vintage convertible.
quiet: Our rooftop party for the new year starts at nine.

notes: Card: ' in' x15, ' with' x7, almost all before 'style'; + pole suppresses 'style'. Probe: fires on the preposition whatever follows: 'birthday in style' 0.516 = 'birthday in the garden' 0.516, 'gala in style' 0.351 = 'gala in a bus' 0.351, 'with style' 0.302; 'in second place' 0.134, 'thank you in person' 0.083, 'written in plain English' 0.001. Near misses drop the preposition from the slot.
